extracted.name: Graham Cracker Cream Pie
extracted.description: VERY EASY and a big hit! Any flavor instant pudding may be used for this pie.
ingredient_lines: 2 (3.5 ounce) packages instant vanilla pudding mix
instruction_lines: Pour milk into a medium bowl. Add pudding mix and whisk until thoroughly combined. Allow to sit 10 minutes.
Fold whipped topping into pudding. Pour mixture into graham cracker crust. Chill before serving.
